Only the values an ADMINISTRATOR owns live here. Enforcement mode and the
uninspectable rule belong to the Web Activity Control policy on the server, not to a per-browser setting.

agentId.title: Endpoint agent identity to report under
agentId.description: The agent_id of the CyberSentinel agent already installed on this device. When set, the extension reports under it and does NOT enrol separately, so the device appears once on the dashboard. Leave unset on a machine with no endpoint agent and the extension enrols on its own.

diagnosticMode.title: Log recovered attachment text to this endpoint's browser console
diagnosticMode.description: Diagnostic aid for working out why OCR missed a document on one machine. The text stays on that machine and is never sent anywhere. Leave off.

wantVersion.title: Published extension version this endpoint should be on
wantVersion.description: Written by manage-windows-agent.ps1 from the server's published build. Policy reaches a running extension immediately, so CHANGING this value is how the installer asks the extension to check its update feed now — the closest thing to pressing Update from outside the browser. The extension compares it with its own version and does nothing when they already match.
